title: limited
body: limited to 3 habits in free version. why would i get an app for only 3 habits.
author: Eliza212beth

title: Can’t believe widget is locked behind a subscription
body: Why does every single app need a subscription? This is a habit tracking app, I’m all for pro features being “add-ons” but the widget?! Really?
author: Manuel Barral

title: Simple and very pleasing to the eye, love it
body:
Makes your habits so acessible and motivates you to keep filling the squares everyday. 
I don’t usually buy the “premium” version of apps, but the widgets alone are worth the money. Amazing
author: iadr97

title: Perfect App
body: Can be a great motivation seeing all those spaces filled. I just love it!!
author: reddoti

title: Best Habit Tracking App
body: I wish there were more affordable plans. People on developer countries could really use a plan that does not cost their minimum income.
author: Nickolas Lago

title: Simple but good.
body: Simple but useful app. Using the app does compel me to complete the habits every day. Of course, I do lapse quite often. Once you have passed three or four months, you get a visual idea of your completion rate. I’m using the free version, so I can’t take advantage of the features that are unlocked with the paid version.
author: Alex.V.64
